Campaign.description:
Campaign object represents a result/response for campaign resource. Campaign is the top-most concept in cold-email
sending and orchestrates email delivery to prospects with configurable scheduling, daily limits, and sender rotation.
Campaign contains an initial email plus multiple followups and sequences. Supports day-of-week scheduling, ESP matching,
progressive daily limit increases, and comprehensive statistics tracking.

activeProspectCount.description: Total number of prospects currently active and enrolled in this campaign.

bccEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to include as BCC (blind carbon copy) recipients on all campaign emails.

body.description: HTML body for the initial campaign email. Include {{SENDER_SIGNATURE}} where the sender's signature should appear; it is not appended automatically. Per-campaign sign-off HTML can be written inline.

bounceCount.description: Number of prospects in this campaign currently marked as bounced, hard and soft, at the last statistics refresh.

campaignId.description: Unique identifier for the email campaign.

ccEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to include as CC (carbon copy) recipients on all campaign emails.

clickCount.description: Total number of link clicks within all campaign emails.

companySendLimit.description:
Company Send Limit: the most new prospects (first emails) at one recipient company (email domain) this campaign emails per UTC day.
null uses the workspace setting (GET /api/v2/account/settings), 0 turns it off for this campaign, 1-100 sets this campaign's own limit.
Follow-ups are never held back and free email providers (gmail.com, outlook.com, ...) are not limited; held-back prospects are emailed on a later day.

conversionCount.description: Total number of conversions tracked across all campaign emails.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the campaign was created in the system.

dailyLimit.description: Maximum number of emails this campaign can send per day; must be between 1 and 10,000.

dailyLimitIncrease.description: Enable automatic progressive increase of the daily sending limit to gradually scale up capacity.

dailyLimitIncreasePercent.description:
Daily percentage increase applied to the sending limit when progressive increase is enabled; must be between 0 and
10,000.

dailyLimitIncreaseToMax.description: Target maximum daily sending limit when progressive increase is enabled; must be between 0 and 10,000.

dailyLimitInitial.description: Separate daily sending limit specifically for initial campaign emails; must be between 1 and 10,000.

dailyLimitInitialEnabled.description: Enable separate daily limit for initial campaign emails distinct from overall campaign limit.

dailyLimitOnDate.description: Current calculated daily limit after applying progressive increases.

dailyLimitPer.description:
Scope for applying the daily limit: 'sender' applies limit per sender account, 'campaign' applies limit across entire
campaign.

dailyLimitPrioritize.description:
Email prioritization strategy when approaching daily limit: 'initial' prioritizes first emails, 'followup' prioritizes
follow-up emails.

dailyLimitWhichEmailsCount.description:
Which email types count toward daily limit: 'all' counts everything, 'initial' counts only first emails, 'followup'
counts only followups.

deactivateIfMissingPlaceholder.description: Automatically deactivate prospect from campaign if required email placeholder/merge tag is missing from their data.

delayMinMinutes.description:
DEPRECATED: holds SECONDS despite the name. Raw passthrough of EM_CAMPAIGN.DelayMin, which the scheduler consumes as
seconds; the earlier "in minutes" description was wrong. Use delayMinSeconds instead; this field will be removed in v3.
Not to be confused with the sender resource's delayMinMinutes, which genuinely holds minutes.

delayMinSeconds.description:
Minimum delay in seconds between sending consecutive emails to avoid spam filters. This is the true seconds value of
EM_CAMPAIGN.DelayMin; it always equals the deprecated delayMinMinutes, which holds the same seconds under a wrong name.

description.description: Optional description explaining the purpose or goal of this campaign; maximum 512 characters.

espLimitEnabled.description: Enable ESP limiting to restrict campaign sends to specific email service providers.

espLimitToGoogle.description: Include Google email providers (Gmail, G Suite) when ESP limiting is enabled.

espLimitToMicrosoft.description: Include Microsoft email providers (Outlook, Hotmail, Live, etc.) when ESP limiting is enabled.

espLimitToOther.description: Include other email providers beyond Microsoft and Google when ESP limiting is enabled.

espMatchEnabled.description: Enable ESP matching to send emails from senders that match prospect's email provider for better deliverability.

espMatchType.description: ESP (Email Service Provider) matching strategy type: 0=none, 1=match sender, 2=match domain.

folderId.description: Folder identifier for organizing and grouping campaigns; must be a positive integer.

fromEmails.description: Comma-separated list of sender email addresses to use for sending campaign emails.

fromName.description: Display name shown in the From field of campaign emails; maximum 128 characters.

initialBounceCount.description: Number of bounces from initial campaign email only (excluding followups).

initialClickCount.description: Number of link clicks from initial campaign email only (excluding followups).

initialConversionCount.description: Number of conversions from initial campaign email only (excluding followups).

initialInterestedCount.description: Number of prospects marked as interested from initial campaign email only (excluding followups).

initialOpenCount.description: Number of email opens from initial campaign email only (excluding followups).

initialReplyCount.description: Number of replies from initial campaign email only (excluding followups).

interestedCount.description: Total number of prospects marked as interested across all campaign emails.

name.description: Campaign display name for identification and organization; maximum 256 characters.

openCount.description: Total number of email opens across all campaign emails.

prospectCount.description: Total number of prospects enrolled in this campaign.

prospectValue.description: Estimated monetary value per prospect conversion for ROI tracking; must be a positive integer.

replyBccEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to BCC on prospect reply emails for internal tracking.

replyCcEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to CC on prospect reply emails for internal tracking.

replyCount.description: Total number of replies received across all campaign emails.

replyToEmail.description:
DEPRECATED: always null. Replies go to each sending mailbox; Reply-To is set per sender (replyTo on
GET/PATCH /api/v2/senders/{id}).

scheduleSending.description: Enable scheduled sending to control when campaign emails are sent during the day.

scheduleTimeZone.description: Timezone identifier for scheduling campaign sends (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'); maximum 64 characters.

Number of prospects in this campaign currently classified as soft-bounced (a temporary delivery failure) at the last

individual contact receiving campaign emails; a campaign enrollment tracks that prospect's progress in one campaign.

sendingActive (for example MissingPlaceholder or BounceHard in this campaign), which are separate from the

sendingActive.description: Whether this prospect is still eligible to receive emails from this campaign.

Clientspace object represents a result/response for clientspace resource. Clientspace is a whitelabel sub-organization
allowing agencies to provide fully branded platforms to clients. Clientspace functions as a workspace with additional
whitelabel capabilities, featuring its own users, campaigns, prospects, and API key with complete data isolation.

apiKey.description: API key for authenticating requests made on behalf of this clientspace, represented as a GUID.

autoAllocate.description: Enables automatic recurring credit allocation to the clientspace, useful for subscription-based credit provisioning.

clientspaceId.description: Unique identifier for the clientspace (whitelabel sub-organization) within the agency.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the clientspace was created in the system.

creditAmount.description:
The number of credits to allocate when auto-allocation is enabled, defining the recurring credit amount for this
clientspace.

separateCredits.description:
Indicates whether the clientspace has a separate credit pool independent from the parent agency, allowing dedicated
credit allocation for this client.

title.description: Display name of the clientspace; maximum 256 characters.

ClientspaceCreditAllocation.description:
ClientspaceCreditAllocation object represents one sending credit allocation from the parent agency to a clientspace.
Allocation fields are those recorded when the allocation was created; balance fields are always current.

agencyBalance.description: Current sending credit balance of the parent agency, read after the allocation.

allocationId.description: Unique identifier of the credit allocation.

amount.description: Number of sending credits moved from the agency to the clientspace.

balance.description: Current sending credit balance of the clientspace, read after the allocation.

clientspaceId.description: Identifier of the clientspace the credits were allocated to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the allocation was created.

externalReference.description: Idempotency key the allocation was created with, or null when none was provided.

note.description:
Free-text note recorded with the allocation; when the request omitted it, the default 'Added from main account'
is recorded and returned.

status.description:
Allocation state: 'pending' while the credit move is in flight, 'completed' when both ledger legs succeeded,
'failed' when the move could not be completed.

ClientspaceCreditAllocationCreate.description:
ClientspaceCreditAllocationCreate object is used for allocating sending credits from the parent agency to a clientspace
with separate credits. The amount is debited from the agency balance and credited to the clientspace balance.

amount.description: Number of sending credits to move from the agency to the clientspace; must be a positive integer.

externalReference.description:
Optional idempotency key, unique per agency; maximum 128 characters. Repeating a request with the same
externalReference returns the original allocation instead of moving credits again. Strongly recommended for
automated integrations that retry on timeout.

note.description: Optional free-text note for the allocation; recorded in the credit ledger; maximum 256 characters.

ClientspaceCreditStatus.description:
ClientspaceCreditStatus object represents the sending credit balance of a clientspace, with an explicit discriminator
for whether the clientspace holds its own credits or shares the parent agency's pool.

agencyBalance.description:
Current sending credit balance of the parent agency. Populated only for agency callers; null when a
clientspace reads its own status.

balance.description:
Effective available sending credits. For 'separate' mode this is the clientspace's own balance; for 'shared' mode
it is the remaining monthly allocation when auto-allocation is enabled, otherwise the parent agency's balance.

clientspaceId.description: Identifier of the clientspace the balance belongs to.

creditMode.description:
Credit mode of the clientspace: 'separate' when it holds its own balance, 'shared' when it draws from the parent
agency's pool (optionally capped by a monthly allocation).

DnsRecord.description:
DnsRecord object represents one DNS record of a domain item on a completed order. Records with managed set are
maintained by Manyreach for the mailboxes and the forwarding of the domain and cannot be changed or deleted
through the API.

host.description: Host relative to the domain: @ for the domain itself, otherwise the name below the domain (for example _dmarc).

id.description: Unique identifier of the record (24 hexadecimal characters); use it with DELETE .../dns-records/{recordId}.

managed.description:
True when Manyreach manages the record for the mailboxes or the forwarding of the domain; such records cannot
be changed or deleted through the API.

priority.description: Priority of an MX record; null for every other type.

status.description: Publication state of the record at the DNS provider.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; 1 means automatic.

value.description: Record value: the text for TXT, the target hostname for CNAME and MX, the address for A and AAAA.

DnsRecordCreate.description:
DnsRecordCreate object is used for adding a DNS record to a domain item on a completed order. TTL is set to
3600 seconds by the server.

host.description:
Host: @ for the domain itself or a name below the domain (for example _mytool); a full name ending in the
domain is accepted and shortened. Managed names (such as _dmarc, www, link, autodiscover and the mailbox DKIM
selectors) are rejected with 422. Maximum 200 characters.

type.description: Record type; only TXT, CNAME, A and AAAA are accepted, any other value is rejected with 422.

value.description:
Record value: printable ASCII text for TXT (one pair of surrounding quotes is removed), a hostname for CNAME,
an IPv4 address for A, an IPv6 address for AAAA. Maximum 2048 characters.

nextCursor is always null.

no forwarding.

DomainForwardingUpdate.description:
DomainForwardingUpdate object is used for changing where a domain item on a completed order redirects its web
visitors. Removing forwarding is not supported.

url.description:
Required. New forwarding target: an absolute http:// or https:// URL, or a bare host with an optional path
(for example example.com/welcome). It is stored as sent. It cannot point at the domain itself or one of its
subdomains. Maximum 256 characters.

Error.description:
Error object represents a result/response for error resource. Error is an audit record capturing errors across
the email campaign platform including sending failures, receiving issues, warmup disconnections, and system errors.
Error provides observability and troubleshooting capabilities with references to associated campaigns, senders,
prospects, and followups along with detailed error messages and server context for distributed debugging.

action.description: Error action code or category identifying the type of error (e.g. send_gmail_oauth, receive_imap, warmup_disconnected).

campaignId.description: Campaign associated with this error if the error occurred during campaign operations.

context.description: Reference value providing additional context such as email address, ID, or other identifiers; maximum 128 characters.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the error occurred in UTC.

description.description: Detailed error description including stack traces and additional context for debugging; maximum 4000 characters.

errorId.description: Unique identifier for the error record.

followupId.description: Followup email associated with this error if the error occurred during followup sending.

message.description: Short error message providing a brief description of what went wrong; maximum 512 characters.

senderId.description: Sender account associated with this error if the error occurred during sending or receiving operations.

ErrorDuplicate.description:
Conflict error (409, type DUPLICATE_RESOURCE) returned when the mailbox is already an active sender in this
account. senderId identifies that sender so it can be reconnected with POST /api/v2/senders/{id}/reconnect.

senderId.description: ID of the existing sender with this email address. Null when the conflict is not with a sender in this account.

status.description: HTTP status code (yes, redundant with HTTP, but RFC 7807 includes it for logging convenience)

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem

ErrorPage.description:
ErrorPage object represents a paginated list of error resources with cursor-based pagination. Error is an audit record
capturing errors across the email campaign platform including sending failures, receiving issues, warmup disconnections,
and system errors. Error provides observability and troubleshooting capabilities with references to associated
campaigns, senders, prospects, and followups along with detailed error messages and server context for distributed
debugging.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

FindEmailsPerson.description: One person to find an email for.

company.description: Company name, stored on the prospect.

companyDomain.description: Company domain, for example "acme.com" (used when companyWebsite is empty).

customFields.description: Custom field name to value, stored on the prospect.

firstName.description: First name (with lastName and a company website or domain).

jobTitle.description: Job title, stored on the prospect.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL (linkedin.com/in/…). Enough on its own.

ref.description: Your own reference for this person (up to 64 characters), echoed in rejected and in the batch results. Default: "r" + the 1-based position.

FindEmailsRejected.description: A person that was not searched.

reason.description: Why: missing_person_key (needs a LinkedIn URL, or first name + last name + company website), duplicate, invalid_linkedin_url or invalid_website.

ref.description: Your ref (or "r" + the 1-based position when you sent none).

FindEmailsRequest.description:
Find verified emails for people you already know (for example rows of a file or a LinkedIn list). Each person needs
linkedinUrl, or firstName + lastName + companyWebsite (or companyDomain).
Runs in the background: poll GET /api/v2/lead-search/batches/{batchId}.

campaignId.description: Also add the prospects to this campaign.

listId.description: Add the prospects to this existing list. Use either listId or listName.

listName.description: Create a new list with this name and add the prospects to it.

people.description: Required. 1 to 5,000 people (above 5,000: 400). Needs a balance of 10 Data Tokens per accepted person; only new verified emails added are charged (10 each).

tag.description: Tag the new prospects with this tag name (created when missing). Default "Find Leads YYYY-MM-DD".

FindEmailsResponse.description: Find-emails batch started. Poll GET /api/v2/lead-search/batches/{batchId} for progress and per-person results.

maxTokens.description: Most Data Tokens this batch can use (accepted × 10). Only new verified emails added are charged.

rejected.description: People not searched, with the reason.

Followup.description:
Followup object represents a result/response for followup resource. Followup is an automated email message sent
after the initial campaign email based on wait times and conditions. Followup can send as a reply in the same thread and
includes tracking statistics for opens, clicks, and replies.

body.description: HTML email body for this followup. Include {{SENDER_SIGNATURE}} where the sender's signature should appear; it is not appended automatically.

bounceCount.description: Total number of bounce responses received for this followup email.

clickCount.description: Total number of link clicks within this followup email.

followupId.description: Unique identifier for the followup email.

interestedCount.description: Total number of prospects marked as interested from this followup email.

openCount.description: Total number of times this followup email was opened by recipients.

replyCount.description: Total number of replies received to this followup email.

replyInThread.description: Reply as a thread to the original email conversation.

replyInThreadToFollowupId.description: Reference to a specific earlier followup ID to reply to within the thread; must be a positive integer.

sendInSameThread.description: Send this followup as a reply in the same email thread as the initial campaign email.

sentCount.description: Total number of times this followup email was sent to prospects.

sequenceId.description: Sequence identifier that this followup belongs to, if part of a conditional sequence.

subject.description: Email subject line for this followup; maximum 1,024 characters.

useOriginalSubject.description: Use the original campaign subject line instead of a custom subject for this followup.

waitMin.description: Wait time duration before sending this followup; must be an integer between 1 and 1000

waitUnits.description: Time unit for the wait period (e.g., 'minutes', 'hours', 'days').

FollowupCreate object is used for creating a new followup resource. Followup is an automated email message sent after the

body.description: HTML email body for this followup. Include {{SENDER_SIGNATURE}} where the sender's signature should appear; it is not appended automatically.

replyInThread.description: Reply as a thread to the original email conversation.

replyInThreadToFollowupId.description: Reference to a specific earlier followup ID to reply to within the thread; must be a positive integer.

sendInSameThread.description: Send this followup as a reply in the same email thread as the initial campaign email.

subject.description: Email subject line for this followup; maximum 1,024 characters.

useOriginalSubject.description: Use the original campaign subject line instead of a custom subject for this followup.

waitMin.description: Wait time duration before sending this followup; must be an integer between 1 and 1000

waitUnits.description: Time unit for the wait period (e.g., 'minutes', 'hours', 'days').

reply in the same thread and includes tracking statistics for opens, clicks, and replies.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

body.description: HTML email body for this followup. Include {{SENDER_SIGNATURE}} where the sender's signature should appear; it is not appended automatically.

replyInThread.description: Reply as a thread to the original email conversation.

replyInThreadToFollowupId.description: Reference to a specific earlier followup ID to reply to within the thread; must be a positive integer.

sendInSameThread.description: Send this followup as a reply in the same email thread as the initial campaign email.

subject.description: Email subject line for this followup; maximum 1,024 characters.

useOriginalSubject.description: Use the original campaign subject line instead of a custom subject for this followup.

waitMin.description: Wait time duration before sending this followup; must be an integer between 1 and 1000

waitUnits.description: Time unit for the wait period (e.g., 'minutes', 'hours', 'days').

LeadSearchBatchResult.description: Result for one person of a find-emails batch.

email.description: Email for Added, CompanyChanged and AlreadyInCrm, else null.

outcome.description:
Added, AlreadyInCrm, NotFound, Risky, BadInput, Unmatched, CompanyChanged,
            OverTarget, or NotSearched (not searched yet, or the batch stopped first).

prospectId.description: Prospect ID for Added, CompanyChanged and AlreadyInCrm, else null.

LeadSearchBatchStatus.description: Progress and results of a search or find-emails batch.

added.description: New prospects added (charged 10 Data Tokens each).

companyChanged.description: Find emails: people now at a different company than given (added and charged).

completedAt.description: When the batch finished (UTC), null while it runs.

duplicates.description: Emails already in this account (free; added to the list, not to the campaign).

prospectIds.description: IDs of the prospects added (use them with the prospect endpoints).

requested.description: Search: target. Find emails: accepted people.

results.description: Find emails only (null for searches): one result per accepted person.

risky.description: Emails found but not safe to send to (free, not added).

round.description: Search round (1 to 3), or part of a find-emails batch.

stage.description: Step of a running batch: Queued, Searching or FindingEmails; null when not running.

status.description:
Queued, Running, Paused (not enough Data Tokens to continue; add Data Tokens and resume it in the app),
            Completed, MatchesRanOut (fewer matches than requested), Stopped (cancelled), Failed or
            TimedOut. Every status except Queued, Running and Paused is final.

LeadSearchFilterOption.description: One allowed filter value: send code, show name.

code.description: Value to send in the filter.

LeadSearchFilterOptions.description:
Allowed values for the lookup filters of LeadSearchFilters. Send countries[].code and
regions[].code (not the names), and industries, employeeRanges and revenueRanges
exactly as listed. textFields names the filters that take free text instead.

countries.description: Countries: send code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) in countries / excludeCountries.

regions.description: Regions: send code in regions / excludeRegions.

textFields.description: Filters that accept free text (any value, up to 50 values of 200 characters each), for example jobTitles.

LeadSearchFilters.description:
Who to look for. Every filter is a flat list: people must match at least one value of each list you fill
(OR inside a list, AND between lists), and must not match any value of an exclude… list. Leave a list out or
empty to ignore it. At least one value in any list is required.
Free-text lists (jobTitles, personLocations, companyNames, cities, companyKeywords,
services) take up to 50 values of up to 200 characters each. Lookup lists (countries, regions,
industries, employeeRanges, revenueRanges) only accept the exact values returned by
GET /api/v2/lead-search/filters; other values make the request fail with 422.

companyKeywords.description: Words that describe what the company does, free text (for example "payroll", "dental clinic").

companyNames.description: Company names to match, free text. To target exact companies use companyDomains on the request instead.

countries.description: Country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example "US", "DE"). Allowed values: countries[].code from GET /api/v2/lead-search/filters.

employeeRanges.description: Company size ranges. Allowed values: employeeRanges from GET /api/v2/lead-search/filters.

excludeCities.description: Cities to leave out, free text.

excludeCompanyKeywords.description: Company keywords to leave out, free text.

excludeCompanyNames.description: Company names to leave out, free text.

excludeCountries.description: Country codes to leave out (same values as countries).

excludeEmployeeRanges.description: Company size ranges to leave out (same values as employeeRanges).

excludeIndustries.description: Industries to leave out (same values as industries).

excludeJobTitles.description: Job titles to leave out, free text.

excludePersonLocations.description: Person locations to leave out, free text.

excludeRegions.description: Region codes to leave out (same values as regions).

excludeRevenueRanges.description: Revenue ranges to leave out (same values as revenueRanges).

excludeServices.description: Services to leave out, free text.

industries.description: Company industries. Allowed values: industries from GET /api/v2/lead-search/filters.

jobTitles.description: Job titles to match, free text (for example "Founder", "Head of Sales"). Seniority and department words go here too.

personLocations.description: Where the person lives, free text (for example "London", "Bavaria", "United States").

regions.description: Region codes. Allowed values: regions[].code from GET /api/v2/lead-search/filters.

revenueRanges.description: Company revenue ranges. Allowed values: revenueRanges from GET /api/v2/lead-search/filters.

services.description: Services the company offers, free text. Suggestions: GET /api/v2/lead-search/services?q=.

LeadSearchPerson.description: A person matching a search (preview rows have no email).

alreadyInCrm.description: True when this person is already a prospect in this account (see prospectId).

foundBefore.description: True when this account already got this person from an earlier search.

prospectId.description: Prospect ID when alreadyInCrm is true, else null.

title.description: Job title.

LeadSearchPreviewRequest.description: Free preview of a search: how many people match and the first 50 of them (no emails).

companyDomains.description: Only people at these companies: website domains such as "acme.com" (a URL also works; free-mail domains are ignored). Up to 10,000.

excludeCompanyDomains.description: Leave out people at these companies (same format as companyDomains). Up to 10,000.

filters.description: Who to look for. See LeadSearchFilters.

maxPerCompany.description: At most this many people per company: 1, 2, 3 or 5. Leave out for any number.

LeadSearchPreviewResponse.description: Preview result: match count and the first 50 people (no emails). Previews never use Data Tokens.

alreadyInCrm.description: How many of people are already prospects in this account.

foundBefore.description: How many of people this account already got from an earlier search (a search skips them when skipFoundBefore is true).

totalApprox.description: True when total is an estimate (long company lists are counted in parts).

LeadSearchServices.description: Service suggestions for the services filter.

services.description: Up to 20 service names matching the query.

LeadSearchStartRequest.description:
Start a search that finds verified emails of new people and adds them as prospects. Runs in the background:
poll GET /api/v2/lead-search/batches/{batchId}.

campaignId.description: Also add the prospects to this campaign. Without listId / listName they go to the Unassigned list.

companyDomains.description: Only people at these companies: website domains such as "acme.com". Up to 10,000.

excludeCompanyDomains.description: Leave out people at these companies. Up to 10,000.

filters.description: Who to look for. See LeadSearchFilters.

listId.description: Add the prospects to this existing list. Use either listId or listName.

listName.description: Create a new list with this name and add the prospects to it. When no list or campaign is given, a new list is created with a default name.

maxPerCompany.description: At most this many people per company: 1, 2, 3 or 5. Leave out for any number.

skipFoundBefore.description: Skip people this account already got from an earlier search. Default true.

tag.description: Tag the new prospects with this tag name (created when missing). Default "Find Leads YYYY-MM-DD".

target.description:
Required. New verified emails wanted, 1 to 5,000 (above 5,000: 400). The search stops when it has this many.
            Needs a balance of target × 10 Data Tokens; only new verified emails added are charged (10 each).

LeadSearchStartResponse.description: Search started. Poll GET /api/v2/lead-search/batches/{batchId} for progress.

maxTokens.description: Most Data Tokens this batch can use (target × 10). Only new verified emails added are charged.

List.description:
List object represents a result/response for list resource. List is a collection organizing and grouping
prospects for campaign management. List belongs to a folder and can contain multiple prospects. List can be shared
across the organization or kept private to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the list was created in the system.

description.description: Optional description explaining the purpose or source of this list; maximum 4,000 characters.

folderId.description: Folder identifier for organizing and grouping lists; must be a positive integer.

listId.description: Unique identifier for the mailing list.

title.description: Display name of the mailing list; maximum 256 characters.

ListCreate.description:
ListCreate object is used for creating a new list resource. List is a collection organizing and grouping prospects
for campaign management. List belongs to a folder and can contain multiple prospects. List can be shared across the
organization or kept private to users.

description.description: Optional description explaining the purpose or source of this list; maximum 4,000 characters.

folderId.description: Folder identifier for organizing and grouping lists; must be a positive integer.

title.description: Display name of the mailing list; maximum 256 characters.

ListPage.description:
ListPage object represents a paginated list of list resources with cursor-based pagination. List is a collection
organizing and grouping prospects for campaign management. List belongs to a folder and can contain multiple prospects.
List can be shared across the organization or kept private to users.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

ListUpdate.description:
ListUpdate object is used for updating an existing list resource. List is a collection organizing and grouping
prospects for campaign management. List belongs to a folder and can contain multiple prospects. List can be shared
across the organization or kept private to users.

description.description: Optional description explaining the purpose or source of this list; maximum 4,000 characters.

folderId.description: Folder identifier for organizing and grouping lists; must be a positive integer.

title.description: Display name of the mailing list; maximum 256 characters.

Message.description:
Message object represents a result/response for message resource. Message is a unified representation of email
messages in the platform, containing both sent messages and replies. Message includes tracking information for opens and
clicks, email content, and relationships to campaigns and followups for comprehensive email thread management.

body.description: The body content of the email message. HTML content should be handled or sanitized appropriately on the client side.

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign this message is associated with, if applicable.

clickCount.description: Number of times links in this message were clicked. Only applicable to SENT messages.

clickDetails.description: Detailed click tracking information for links in the message. Only applicable to SENT messages.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was created or sent.

followupId.description: Followup ID (FUID) associated with this message, if applicable.

messageId.description: Unique identifier for the message, using either SentID or ReplyID depending on the message type.

openCount.description: Number of times this message was opened. Only applicable to SENT messages.

senderId.description: ID of the connected sender mailbox that received the reply. Set on Reply messages; null on Sent messages.

type.description: Message type indicating whether this is a sent message or a reply. Valid values: SENT or REPLY.

MessagePage.description:
MessagePage object represents a paginated list of message resources with cursor-based pagination. Message is a unified
representation of email messages in the platform, containing both sent messages and replies. Message includes tracking
information for opens and clicks, email content, and relationships to campaigns and followups for comprehensive email
thread management.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

MessageReply.description: Request model for sending an email reply to a received message.

attachments.description:
Optional file attachments for the reply. Not stored in DB; sent in-memory only.
Each item: FileName, ContentType, ContentBase64 (base64-encoded file content).

bccEmails.description:
Comma-separated list of email addresses to include as BCC (blind carbon copy) recipients.
Each email address must be valid. Example: "bcc1@example.com,bcc2@example.com"

body.description:
HTML email body content for the reply. Can include personalization placeholders 
(e.g., {FirstName}, {Company}) that will be replaced with prospect data.
If SendAsReply is true, the original message will be appended as a quoted block.
body.example: <p>Thank you for your message. Here's my response...</p>

ccEmails.description:
Comma-separated list of email addresses to include as CC (carbon copy) recipients.
Each email address must be valid. Example: "cc1@example.com,cc2@example.com"

fromEmail.description:
Sender email address to use for the From header. Must be a valid, configured sender 
account in your organization. If omitted, the system will use the sender from the 
original received message. Must be a valid email format.

messageId.description:
ID of the received message to reply to. This is the Message-ID from the email headers.
Required field.

replyToEmail.description:
Email of the prospect you're replying to (optional). If left empty, it will reply to the thread prospect's email. 
If passed, it will take precedence

sendAsReply.description:
If true, appends the original received message as a quoted reply block in the email body.
The quoted text will include the original sender, timestamp, and message content.
Default: false

subject.description:
Email subject line for the reply. If omitted, the original message subject will be used.
Maximum 4,000 characters.
subject.example: Re: Your inquiry about our services

OauthApp.description: OauthApp is your own (BYO) OAuth client that senders of this account can connect with. The client secret is never returned.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID of the app.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in UTC. Null for apps created before this field existed.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the app; pass it as oauthAppId on POST /api/v2/senders/connect,
POST /api/v2/senders/{id}/reconnect and POST /api/v2/oauth/sessions.

title.description: Your name for the app.

OauthAppCreate.description:
OauthAppCreate registers your own (BYO) OAuth client. The provider comes from the URL. Add
https://app.manyreach.com/e/auth/googlecallback as an authorized redirect URI of the client before using it for
hosted sessions.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID; maximum 256 characters. Cannot be changed later.

secret.description: OAuth client secret; maximum 256 characters. Write-only: never returned.

title.description: Your name for the app; maximum 256 characters.

OauthAppPage.description: OauthAppPage is a page of your OAuth apps.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

OauthAppUpdate.description:
OauthAppUpdate changes the title or rotates the secret of your OAuth app. Only the fields you send change; the client ID
cannot be changed. Senders using the app pick up a new secret on their next token refresh.

secret.description: New OAuth client secret; 1 to 256 characters. Write-only: never returned.

title.description: Your name for the app; maximum 256 characters.

OauthSession.description: OauthSession is a hosted OAuth sign-in for one mailbox. Never contains tokens.

authUrl.description:
Only returned when the session is created; null on reads. Single-use sign-in link bound to email: open it as
that mailbox and do not publish it.

batchId.description: Identifier shared by the sessions of one bulk create; null for a single create. Filter the list with it.

clientId.description:
OAuth client ID used by authUrl. A Google Workspace admin trusts this client under Security > API controls > App
access control.

completedAt.description: When the session reached Connected or Failed (UTC); otherwise null.

email.description: Email address of the mailbox that must sign in.

error.description: Why the session failed, or why the last sign-in did not complete while it is still Pending; otherwise null.

expiresAt.description: When the sign-in link stops working (UTC).

mode.description: Connect adds a new sender; Reconnect renews the tokens of the existing sender with this email.

senderId.description: ID of the connected sender once status is Connected; otherwise null.

OauthSessionBulkCreate.description:
OauthSessionBulkCreate starts one hosted OAuth sign-in per mailbox (1 to 200), sharing the settings below. Every mailbox
gets a session in the response, in request order; mailboxes that cannot be connected get a Failed session with
error and no authUrl.

dailyLimit.description: Maximum number of emails each new sender can send per day; must be between 1 and 10,000. Not changed on a reconnect.

expiresInMinutes.description: Minutes until the sessions expire; between 10 and 10080 (7 days). Default 4320 (72 hours).

folder.description: Organizational folder name for the new senders; maximum 64 characters. Not changed on a reconnect.

oauthAppId.description:
ID of your own Google OAuth app to sign in with (GET /api/v2/oauth/Google/apps). Its client must list
https://app.manyreach.com/e/auth/googlecallback as an authorized redirect URI. Needs an active plan, UltraMode or
Clientspace subscription (403 for the whole request); an unknown id returns 404. Google only; cannot be combined with
platformOAuthApp.

platformOAuthApp.description: Hosted Google OAuth app to sign in with. Omit or Auto for the account default. Google only.

provider.description: Mailbox provider of every session: Google or Microsoft.

sessions.description: Mailboxes, 1 to 200, each email at most once.

warmup.description: Enable warmup on the new senders. Warmup stays off when the email domain has no mail server.

OauthSessionBulkItem.description: OauthSessionBulkItem is one mailbox of a bulk session create.

email.description: Email address of the mailbox; sign-in must be with exactly this mailbox. Maximum 100 characters.

fromName.description: Display name shown as the sender in outgoing emails; maximum 128 characters. Not changed on a reconnect.

OauthSessionBulkResult.description: OauthSessionBulkResult lists the sessions of one bulk create in request order.

batchId.description: Identifier shared by these sessions; poll GET /api/v2/oauth/sessions?batchId=....

failed.description: Number of mailboxes that cannot be connected (see each item's error).

items.description: One session per mailbox, in request order.

pending.description: Number of sessions waiting for sign-in.

submitted.description: Number of mailboxes in the request.

OauthSessionCreate.description:
OauthSessionCreate starts a hosted OAuth sign-in for one mailbox. The response carries an authUrl: open it and sign in
as email; the mailbox is then connected as a sender (or, when an OAuth sender with this email already exists in this
account, its tokens are renewed). Poll GET /api/v2/oauth/sessions/{id} for the result.

dailyLimit.description: Maximum number of emails the new sender can send per day; must be between 1 and 10,000. Not changed on a reconnect.

email.description:
Email address of the mailbox. Sign-in must be with exactly this mailbox (compared case-insensitively; aliases are not
accepted). Maximum 100 characters.

expiresInMinutes.description: Minutes until the session expires; between 10 and 10080 (7 days). Default 4320 (72 hours).

folder.description: Organizational folder name for the new sender; maximum 64 characters. Not changed on a reconnect.

fromName.description: Display name shown as the sender in outgoing emails; maximum 128 characters. Not changed on a reconnect.

oauthAppId.description:
ID of your own Google OAuth app to sign in with (GET /api/v2/oauth/Google/apps). Its client must list
https://app.manyreach.com/e/auth/googlecallback as an authorized redirect URI. Needs an active plan, UltraMode or
Clientspace subscription (403); an unknown id returns 404. Google only; cannot be combined with platformOAuthApp.

platformOAuthApp.description: Hosted Google OAuth app to sign in with. Omit or Auto for the account default. Google only.

warmup.description: Enable warmup on the new sender. Warmup stays off when the email domain has no mail server.

OauthSessionPage.description: OauthSessionPage is a page of hosted OAuth sessions.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

Order.description:
Order object represents a result/response for order resource. Order is a purchase for domains and managed
mailboxes, carrying the registrant contact details required for domain registration and the line items being
provisioned. Order moves through Stripe checkout before its items begin provisioning.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created in the system.

forwardingDomain.description: The catch-all forwarding domain for the order.

items.description: Line items belonging to this order. Null on the list endpoint; populated on GET /api/v2/orders/{id} and GET /api/v2/orders/draft.

mailboxPlatform.description: Mailbox platform the order provisions, or null when not yet chosen on a draft.

registrantAddress.description: Street address of the domain registrant.

registrantEmail.description: Email address of the domain registrant.

registrantFirstName.description: First name of the domain registrant.

registrantLastName.description: Last name of the domain registrant.

registrantPhone.description: Phone number of the domain registrant.

registrantPostalCode.description: Postal code of the domain registrant.

registrantStateProvince.description: State or province of the domain registrant.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order.

OrderCheckout.description:
OrderCheckout object represents a result/response for the order checkout action. CheckoutUrl is a hosted
Stripe checkout page that expires and is returned only by POST /api/v2/orders/{id}/checkout.

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted Stripe checkout page URL for the order; expires after a limited time.

orderId.description: Unique identifier for the order being checked out.

OrderCreate.description:
OrderCreate object is used for the get-or-create draft order action. The request body is intentionally empty:
POST /api/v2/orders returns the organization's existing mailbox draft or creates one with no input fields.
Set registrant, forwarding, mailbox platform and line items afterwards via PATCH and the item endpoints.

OrderItem.description:
OrderItem object represents a result/response for order item resource. OrderItem is a single domain or mailbox
being provisioned within an order, tracking its status and detailed provisioning progress.

itemId.description: Unique identifier for the order item.

provisioning.description: Detailed provisioning status for the item.

status.description: Current provisioning status of the item.

title.description: Title of the item: apex domain for domain items, full email address for mailbox items.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the item, or null when it has not been modified.

OrderItemCreate.description:
OrderItemCreate object is used for creating a new order item resource within an existing order. OrderItem is a
single domain or mailbox being provisioned.

description.description: Free-form description of the item; maximum 1,024 characters.

title.description: Title of the item: apex domain for domain items, full email address for mailbox items; maximum 128 characters.

type.description:
Type of the order item. Only Domain, DomainExternal and Mailbox are accepted; DomainPast is server-derived
and rejected with 422.

OrderItemPage.description:
OrderItemPage object represents a paginated list of order item resources with cursor-based pagination.
OrderItem is a single domain or mailbox being provisioned within an order.

items.description: Array of items in the current page

pagination.description: Pagination metadata with typed primary key support

OrderItemProvisioning.description:
OrderItemProvisioning object represents a result/response for order item provisioning resource. OrderItemProvisioning
carries the outcome of each domain registration and DNS setup step for one order item. Steps that cannot apply to the

Sender object represents a result/response for sender resource. Sender is an email account used to send campaign
emails. Sender is configurable with custom SMTP/IMAP settings, warmup configurations, and daily sending limits. Sender
can be associated with multiple campaigns and supports rotation to distribute sending across accounts.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the sender account was created in the system.

customImapPort.description: IMAP server port number for custom email retrieval configuration; typically 993 for SSL/TLS.

customImapServer.description: IMAP server hostname for custom email retrieval configuration; maximum 128 characters.

customImapUsername.description: Custom IMAP username if different from the sender email; maximum 128 characters.

customSmtpPort.description: SMTP server port number for custom email sending configuration.

customSmtpServer.description: SMTP server hostname for custom email sending configuration; maximum 128 characters.

customWarmupTag.description: Custom tag applied to emails sent during warmup phase for tracking and filtering purposes; maximum 64 characters.

dailyLimit.description: Maximum number of emails this sender can send per day; must be between 1 and 10,000.

dailyLimitIncrease.description: Enable automatic progressive increase of the daily sending limit to scale up sending capacity over time.

dailyLimitIncreasePercent.description: Daily percentage increase applied to the sending limit when progressive increase is enabled; must be between 1 and 100.

dailyLimitIncreaseToMax.description: Target maximum daily sending limit when using progressive increase; must be greater than current daily limit.

dateDisconnected.description: Timestamp when the sender account was disconnected from the email provider.

dateWarmupDisconnected.description: Timestamp when the system removed the sender from the public warmup network; cleared when a user turns warmup off on a connected sender.

delayMin.description:
DEPRECATED: holds MINUTES despite the seconds claim in earlier descriptions. Raw passthrough of EM_SENDER.DelayMin,
which the scheduler consumes as minutes. Use delayMinMinutes instead; this field will be removed in v3.

delayMinMinutes.description:
Minimum delay in minutes between sending consecutive emails from this sender. This is the true minutes value of
EM_SENDER.DelayMin; it always equals the deprecated delayMin. Until v3 the campaign resource also carries a
delayMinMinutes field, which is deprecated and actually holds seconds; this one genuinely holds minutes.

disconnected.description:
Indicates whether the sender account is currently disconnected from the email provider due to authentication or
connection issues.

disconnectionReason.description: Reason why the sender account was disconnected; maximum 128 characters.

email.description: Email address of the sender account used for outgoing campaigns; must be valid email format with maximum 100 characters.

firstName.description: Sender's first name used for personalization in campaigns; maximum 128 characters.

folder.description: Organizational folder name for grouping and categorizing sender accounts; maximum 64 characters.

fromName.description: Display name shown as the sender in outgoing emails; maximum 128 characters.

lastName.description: Sender's last name used for personalization in campaigns; maximum 128 characters.

managed.description:

connected or reconnected via the API; manage them on the mailboxes page.

oauthAppId.description:
ID of your own Google OAuth app this sender's tokens belong to. Null when a hosted app (see
platformOAuthAppUsed) or the account's default credentials are used.

paused.description: true when sending is paused for this sender: no campaign emails and no warmup emails are sent until it is resumed (set paused: false).

platformOAuthAppUsed.description:
Hosted Google OAuth app this sender's tokens belong to. Null when your own app (oauthAppId) is used, for
non-Google senders, and when both fields are null: the sender uses the account's default credentials.

replyTo.description:
Reply-to email address for responses to campaigns; must be valid email format, maximum 128 characters. If set, Unibox
will not catch replies unless Reply-to sender is also connected as sender.

tags.description: Tags linked to this sender (from EM_TAG_SENDER). Empty list when none.

warmup.description: Enable warmup to gradually build sender reputation. Warmup only runs while the sender is not paused (see paused).

warmupDailyLimit.description: Initial daily sending limit when starting the warmup process; default 10 emails per day.

warmupDailyLimitIncrease.description: Enable progressive daily limit increase specifically during the warmup period to gradually build sender reputation.

warmupDailyLimitIncreasePercent.description: Daily percentage increase of the sending limit during warmup period; must be between 1 and 10,000.

warmupDailyLimitIncreaseToMax.description: Target maximum daily sending limit to reach during the warmup phase; must be between 1 and 10,000.

warmupRemovalReason.description: Reason why the system removed the sender from the public warmup network; cleared when a user turns warmup off on a connected sender; maximum 128 characters.

warmupReplyPercent.description:
Percentage of warmup emails that will receive automated replies to simulate natural conversation; must be between 1 and
100.

warmupSkipWeekends.description: Skip sending warmup emails on Saturday and Sunday to simulate natural business communication patterns.

SenderCampaignDay.description: Campaign emails of one sender sent on one UTC day, with the bounces, opens, clicks and replies they received so far.

clicked.description: Emails sent on this day with at least one tracked link click.

date.description: The UTC day the emails were sent.

hardBounced.description:
Prospects whose first email, sent on this day, bounced permanently (hard bounce) at any step. Soft bounces before
2026-09-03 are counted here.

initialSent.description: First emails of a sequence sent on this day.

opened.description: Emails sent on this day that were opened at least once.

replied.description: Emails sent on this day that got at least one reply (auto-replies excluded).

sent.description: Campaign emails sent on this day (every step).

softBounced.description:
Prospects whose first email, sent on this day, got a temporary delivery failure (soft bounce): not suppressed, and a
hard bounce after 3 occurrences. Soft-bounce classification started on 2026-09-03.

SenderCampaignStats.description:
Campaign email statistics of one sender for a range of UTC days, with one entry per day. Counted by the day each email
was sent (UTC); warmup emails are not included.

bounceRate.description: hardBounced / initialSent * 100, rounded to one decimal (hard bounces only). Null when initialSent is 0.

SenderTestEmailCreate.description:
Request model for sending a test email from a sender, for example for an inbox placement test. Each address in
to gets its own email.

body.description:
HTML body of the test email, 1 to 100,000 characters; plain text is accepted and sent as is. Placeholders inside
{{ }} (for example {{SENDER_SIGNATURE}}) are filled in and spintax is processed, the same as for test
emails sent from the app. Prospect placeholders are filled from the prospect with the recipient's address in your
account, if there is one; otherwise they are empty.

plainText.description: Optional, default false. When true the email is sent as plain text only; an HTML body is converted to text.

subject.description:
Subject of the test email, 1 to 500 characters. Placeholders such as {{SENDER_FIRSTNAME}} and spintax
({|a|b|}) are processed. Put your placement test code here or in body.

to.description:
Addresses to send the test email to: 1 to 10 unique, valid email addresses. Each address gets its own email, so
recipients don't see each other. Duplicates (in any letter case) return 422.

trackClicks.description: Optional, default false. When true links are rewritten through the sender's tracking domain to track clicks.

trackOpens.description: Optional, default false. When true an open-tracking pixel from the sender's tracking domain is added.

SenderTestEmailRecipient.description: Outcome of the test email to one address.

error.description: A readable reason when Failed or Skipped, otherwise null. The wording may change: don't parse it.

messageId.description:
Message-ID of the sent email, without angle brackets; set when Sent. Use it to match the email in a
placement tool.

sentAt.description: When the email was sent (UTC, ISO 8601); set when Sent.

status.description:
Sent: accepted by the sender's mail server. Failed: the send was attempted and failed (see
            error). Blocked: the address is on your blocklist, so it was not sent and not charged.
            Skipped: not attempted (the call's time limit was reached, the sender failed on earlier addresses, or the
            account ran out of sending credits); not charged and not counted toward today's limits.

to.description: The address, as sent in the request (trimmed).

SenderTestEmailResult.description:
Result of a test-email call: one entry per requested address, in request order, plus how many test emails the sender
and the account can still send today.

accountRemainingToday.description: Test emails the account can still send today (UTC day), shared with test emails sent from the app.

creditsUsed.description: Sending credits charged by this call: one per email sent. Repeating a call sends and charges again.

failed.description: Number of addresses with status Failed.

results.description: One entry per address in to, in request order.

senderId.description: Unique identifier of the sender the test emails were sent from.

senderRemainingToday.description: Test emails this sender can still send today (UTC day), shared with test emails sent from the app.

sent.description: Number of addresses with status Sent.
